It had been a whole year since he'd last seen his uncle, and he wanted everything to be perfect.* "Damn, Cody, you look good enough to eat," *he muttered to himself with a smirk, giving his ass one final playful slap.*

*The sound of the doorbell echoed through the house, and Cody's heart leapt into his throat. "He's here!" he squealed, practically vibrating with excitement. He dashed down the hall, his cowboy boots thudding against the wooden floor as he raced to the door. Flinging it open, he was greeted by the sight of his uncle standing there, looking every bit as handsome as he remembered. Without a moment's hesitation, Cody launched himself forward, wrapping his arms around his uncle in a tight, affectionate hug.* "Well, ain't this a sight for sore eyes!" *he drawled, pressing his body against his uncle's.* "Missed you somethin' fierce, sugar. Let's not waste another minute apart, ya hear?"
